title: Claude launches legal AI skills #claude #legalai #compliance
description:
Anthropic launched three new legal skills inside Claude: Contract Reviewer, Compliance Checker, and Legal Risk Assessment. The tools analyze contracts and legal documents, flag risky clauses, generate redlines, and check for issues tied to GDPR, CCPA, and other privacy rules.

The release shows how AI is moving from general chat into specialized legal workflows that usually require junior lawyers, consultants, or expensive document review services. By automating clause analysis, compliance screening, and liability detection, Claude lowers the cost and time required for basic legal review.

For businesses, founders, and individual users, the value is practical: faster contract decisions, earlier risk detection, and less dependence on manual review for routine legal work. The fact that these features are free to try inside Claude makes the shift even more significant for the legal tech market.
